title: [Bug] P1S firmware 01.07.00.00 AMS slots shown as Empty since integration 2.2.23
body:
### Home Assistant Version

2026.9.2

### Bambu Lab Integration Version

2.2.25

### Describe the bug

After upgrading the Bambu Lab integration from 2.2.22 to 2.2.25, all AMS slots on my P1S printers are displayed as Empty, although filament is physically loaded.

This affects three P1S printers, all running firmware 01.07.00.00 with AMS firmware 00.00.06.49.

The raw push_status data received from the printer contains the correct filament type and color for the occupied AMS slots. However, the processed device state in the integration marks all four slots as empty.

A1 and H2D printers with newer firmware do not have this problem.

Downgrading only the Bambu Lab integration from 2.2.25 to 2.2.22 immediately restores correct AMS slot detection. No printer or AMS configuration was changed.

### To Reproduce

1. Use a P1S running firmware 01.07.00.00 with an AMS (00.00.06.49).
2. Load filament into one or more AMS slots.
3. Install Bambu Lab integration 2.2.25.
4. Observe that all AMS slots are reported as Empty in Home Assistant.
5. Downgrade the integration to 2.2.22 and restart Home Assistant.
6. Observe that the same AMS slots and filament information are immediately displayed correctly.

The issue was also tested with both Local MQTT and Bambu Cloud MQTT. The result is the same.

### Expected Behaviour

Occupied AMS slots should be detected as occupied and display their filament type and color.

The integration should correctly handle the older AMS MQTT payload used by P1S firmware 01.07.00.00, where populated tray entries contain tray_type, tray_color and other filament data but do not contain the newer state field.

### What device are you using?

P1S

### Diagnostic Output

[config_entry-bambu_lab-01M2AWADF1MCTYWJKP2CGY4EWH.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32148578/config_entry-bambu_lab-01M2AWADF1MCTYWJKP2CGY4EWH.json)

### Log Extracts

_No response_

### Other Information

This appears to be a regression introduced after version 2.2.22, possibly related to PR #2023 ("Distinguish empty AMS slots from unknown loaded spools").

The raw push_status from the P1S correctly reports the occupied trays. For example, three trays contain tray_type "PLA" and valid tray_color values, and tray_exist_bits is "e0".

However, these tray entries from P1S firmware 01.07.00.00 do not contain the newer "state" field.

After processing by integration 2.2.25, all four trays become:
empty: true
name: "Empty"
type: "Empty"

This suggests that a missing state field in the older P1S payload may be interpreted as an empty tray.

If possible, could the integration fall back to tray_exist_bits and/or the existing tray data when the state field is not present?

I intentionally keep these P1S printers on firmware 01.07.00.00 for compatibility with my existing slicer workflow.

I have reproduced this on three separate P1S printers with the same firmware.
